restrictions: Two distinct 64-byte messages M(x), M(y). W0..W7 are the fixed prefix in proof Section 1. W8=y0, W9=y1, and W10..W15 are y2..y7 minus K10..K15 modulo 2^32. This is a bijection from the 256-bit chain value x. FIPS padding adds one fixed second block. The target uses the standard IV, steps 0..56 on each block, and feed-forward. The walk g is an explicitly invertible encoding of the block-1 working state (walk B with tail shear masks QM=0xb5a1068c and XM=0x583ddb1a) XOR the fixed polarity mask 4e9499340e1bc031b636cc191dc570b0bcf67532d75b52b88e2d198fd76f70a1. A collision of g gives equal complete digests.

Classical 256-bit word RAM under collision-frontier-v5, C=4324. The declared machine has 876 256-bit registers, 871 data, three pointers, and the stage-1 counter and all-ones register. Every XOR, AND, OR, NOT, move, set, load, store, addition, comparison, branch, and random word is charged. Its native body instruction is exactly 32 bits: a 2-bit opcode and three 10-bit register fields, fetched and executed directly at one operation per instruction under the same pricing convention as the accepted native 5-byte format. No decoder or interpreter runs in the normative path. Recovery and control use native fixed 5-byte instructions. The kernel has 73477 instructions (57746 XOR, 9518 AND, 6213 OR; the 73498-instruction kernel of 873176ef after twenty-one exact one-gate window rewrites applied in place by the emitter, three of them after live-range renames, proof Section 1 item (5) and Section D).

Stage 1 is the weighted cascade of proof Section C: 9 ORs, a comparison and a branch (11 operations) and loop control (3) run in every batch (body 73491); the conditional levels (planes 10 to 19, a guard check and the final NOT) are paid through a capped weighted counter, charged once as U + 30 = 2693020612473121829614880551797961012. It replaces the full 20-plane test (22 operations per batch) of 873176ef.

The single attempt uses one fresh uniform r, no restart, no amplification, no stored collision, and no advice. Distinguished points have low 20 bits zero and the next 102 bits below 1833. The table stores 118777 completed trails in 119040 trail-index slots. Each 47-bit slot stores key+1 in a bit-sliced table of 465 groups of 47 aligned 256-bit words (256 trail numbers per group); zero is the empty sentinel, and the slot position is the trail number. Recovery resolves collisions by two-pass checkpoint binary search (cap cr=35968198903945350406998816251994049, kchk=10926, stride D=3291982326921595314570640330588) and uses the 498-record rolled program (110 one-time initialization records), executing 2305 records per call plus at most 39 itemized surrounding operations, including 10 per-call register re-sets.

Exact ledger: B=1324844483889656000000000000000000000, c=101523142067587682600399884582241267, cr=35968198903945350406998816251994049, and N=97453090934107617298807950855023756327509 word operations. log2(N/4324)=124.083680932141. The claim rounds upward to 124.08369. The main loop charges B*73491; a stage-1 cascade row charges U+30 = 2693020612473121829614880551797961012 (capped weighted counter; proof Section C). Final setup and emission cost 342204023 operations. The 1641-evaluation offset search costs 461900436782186496 operations. The reserved 773-evaluation selector-validation envelope costs 217580156997337088 operations. All are included in N and preprocessing_log2.

Search memory is 304138 bytes of code, 699360 bytes of table, 16384 bytes of counters and copies, and 28032 bytes of registers: 1047914 bytes. The 3136-byte recovery array lies inside the 8192-byte plane copy that is part of the counters; that copy is dead when recovery starts (proof Appendix B.1). The table is 465 groups of 47 aligned 32-byte words (proof Section 3.3.1). Normative setup adds a 371952-byte wasm emitter image and 110548 bytes of itemized scratch to the final code, counters, and registers: 831054 bytes. The sequential preprocessing searches peak below setup. Search is the overall peak. The self-test asserts every body, control, key, and trail field boundary.

For a uniformly random 256-bit function, proof Section 4 and Appendix A give P_F at least 0.390000001000 using exact integers and outward-rounded 60-digit decimals. H1 is the score-critical comparison that transfers this bound to the fixed reduced-round SHA-256 walk. Proof Section 5 states its support, scope, and exact sensitivity.

The freestanding C source embedded as GEN_C (SHA-256 e050ccba8e5d994c48b6c133285cd5176620619d3fe7f8f4507ddf5c99870fb9) is the normative setup emitter. Compiled to wasm32 with the stated flags (Ubuntu clang 18.1.3, Ubuntu LLD 18.1.3), its exported run function consumes exactly 170695211 units of participant-measured Wasmtime 50.0.1 fuel (the least completing budget is 11 lower) and emits 73477 instructions. Before every declared experiment, the byte-exact Python BoundedEmitter mirror checks all 15 C fields, the C source hash, stream hash 06fa1f792ef5ab7c2ee1ab6d21e6a5de36ca316cbf21bc3e5fe5d8565fffc40c, polarity mask, bounds, and ordinary-builder equality. Circuit optimizations are exact equivalences checked by the self-test; they are not premises.

The declared organizer experiments are consistency checks. bssha-n16 performs one width-16 search attempt per trial. proj-k0-w256 evaluates 256 full-width points and forms the complete two-block 57-step digest. The organizer recomputes every returned event. No experiment count changes the score.

heuristics.statement: Model premise with four explicit clauses. Let F be a uniformly random function from 256-bit values to 256-bit values and let A_F be this exact bounded attempt with every call to the fixed walk g replaced by lazy sampling from F. H1 states that the real attempt succeeds at least as often as A_F. (a) Distinct fresh evaluated inputs have independent uniform outputs and pair-collision hazard 2^-256. (b) Iterates from the starts r+t have the first-collision law of a random mapping. (c) A fresh output is distinguished with probability 1833/2^122 independently of collision events. (d) Under the program's adaptive choices, given the complete earlier history and the later DP flags, a fresh output equals any fixed earlier non-DP output with probability at least 2^-256. Proof Section 4 proves P_F >= 0.390000001000 for F, and Section 5 states the support and sensitivity of the fixed-target comparison.
heuristics.scope: The fixed target sha256-r57-prefix-v1 restricted to the 64-byte message family of proof Section 1, one attempt of B=1324844483889656000000000000000000000 batches and Q=339160187875751936000000000000000000000 evaluations, about 116925.13 trails of mean length 5316911983139663491615228241121378304/1833 = 2^111.1600, with 256 trails advanced together. It is not claimed for other messages, rounds, or scales.
heuristics.extrapolation: Support of H1 is stated in proof Section 5. (1) H1 is the generic premise of parallel collision search with distinguished points: Paul C. van Oorschot and Michael J. Wiener, 'Parallel Collision Search with Cryptanalytic Applications', Journal of Cryptology 12(1):1-28, 1999, DOI 10.1007/PL00003816, model a fixed compression function iterated from fresh starts, without a chosen input difference, by a random function. The generic entries of this track use the same premise, including the round-64 entries 7523902c and c9ae3732 and the round-57 entries a0da34f4 and 7e276e11. (2) Clause (d) fails adversely only if g, along its own iterates, collides less often than a random function by a factor 1-eps. Such a property would separate this 57-step SHA-256 walk from a random function in a way no published result shows; this entry chooses no input difference and uses no differential property. (3) A higher hazard helps. Replanning a deficit costs 0.00725044 bit at eps=0.01 (Tp 1823), 0.03700365 at eps=0.05 (Tp 1786), 0.07600887 at eps=0.10 (Tp 1739), and 0.20753933 at eps=0.25 (Tp 1587). (4) The program checks agree with random-function references at their scopes: proj-k0-w256 expects 100.53 of 256 trials with a pair; bssha-n16 expects 178.14 of 256 (exact-plan lazy-random-function reference, 10000000 mappings, probability 0.6958435, standard error 0.00014548). 873176ef reported a participant-run 256-trial replay with substitute seeds that returned 99 and 169. For this package a 48-trial replay with substitute seeds returned 17 (proj-k0-w256) and 31 (bssha-n16) trials with a pair, byte-identical to the outputs of the 873176ef source on the same requests, every pair recomputed with the verifier digest. These counts are consistency checks, not inputs to the score.
heuristics.limitations: H1 cannot be tested at width 256: the experiments reach the complete search at width 16 and 16-bit projections of 256 full-width points, so they cannot measure the full-width collision hazard or the success probability at 2^128 scale. The exact sensitivity costs above restore 0.39 under specified hazard deficits. Circuit equivalences, instruction counts, memory bounds, and the theorem for F do not depend on H1. The memory layout of this package (the recovery array inside the plane copy, the bit-sliced table, the 1250-record handler allowance) consists of declared prices and a lifetime argument, not of parts of H1 (proof Appendix B.3).
